scope: Additive Barbarian Puppet L1-18 active summon, Raged Barbarian and Hero-stat evidence audit; do not infer spawn or Rage tick order.
game_version: Official 2023-12-12 launch and 2025-02 balance notice; dated game-file table 2026-09-01 and claimed client build 18.600.3 on 2026-09-18; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Each Hero equips two Equipment items; active effects require battle activation. Barbarian Puppet is Common active Barbarian King Equipment that summons Raged Barbarians and grants Hero HP recovery and HP increase. Replacing it removes the summon ability.
sources.limitations: No summon formation, spawn tick, unit level, Rage timer boundary, activation eligibility or stat application order is stated.

sources.title: Hero Equipment Balance Changes!
facts: Supercell announced a Barbarian Puppet buff for the February 2025 update.
sources.limitations: The article gives no changed numeric value or exact rollout build.

sources.title: Temperamental Tentacles Update!
facts: The Equipment UI displays Rage duration and damage increase for Barbarians spawned by Barbarian Puppet.
sources.limitations: The article gives no spawn ordering, concrete Rage duration values or damage calculation stage.

sources.title: Barbarian Puppet: levels, costs and times — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: The maximum is L18, and the page lists per-level upgrade costs and Blacksmith requirements.
sources.limitations: No per-level summoned count, Rage scalar, Hero recovery, unit level or summon geometry is supplied.

sources.title: Barbarian Puppet — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The L1-18 Hero HP bonus runs from 309 to 3366; ore costs and Blacksmith requirements agree with GiBiArena.
sources.limitations: The page omits per-level summoned count, Rage damage and duration, Hero HP recovery and spawned unit level.

sources.title: Pinned Barbarian Puppet Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The normalized per-level source_fields preserve summonedBarbarians, barbarianDamageIncrease, barbarianSpeedIncrease, hitpointIncrease and hpRecoveryIncrease. The top-level ability records barbarianRageDuration 20.
sources.limitations: Exact current-build continuity of spawn count, Rage scalars and HP recovery is unconfirmed. The raw payload does not define spawned unit level, position, target state, collision or effect tick order.

derivations.result: Keep the pinned per-level summon and Hero-stat fields data-only
derivations.method: The frozen raw payload is SHA-checked against normalized source_fields, while two dated tables corroborate L1-18 HP boosts and ore costs. No missing spawn or Rage rule is inferred.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn all Barbarians at the King's center in one Core tick
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source defines placement, collision resolution, ordering or whether the count arrives simultaneously.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the current regular Barbarian troop level for each summoned unit
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source gives spawned Barbarian level selection or stat mapping.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat +100% to +220% Rage damage and speed fields as a complete 20-second buff contract
rejected_inferences.reason: The source fields do not define application phase, tick boundary, interaction with other modifiers or current-build continuity.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Hero HP increase and recovery immediately when the ability activates
rejected_inferences.reason: The official table distinguishes HP increase and recovery, but their prebattle versus activation timing and order remain unspecified.

items: current-build summon count, Rage and Hero recovery continuity
Equipment selection, activation command and two-slot conflict rules
summoned Barbarian unit level and relation to ordinary Barbarian stats
spawn count, placement, collision and deterministic entity-ID order
Rage duration boundaries, damage and speed modifier order
Hero max-HP increase and activation recovery timing
King death, Phoenix revival and other Equipment interaction order
spawned-unit targeting, movement, traps and battlefield art rights

conclusion: Barbarian Puppet L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Its active summon and Hero bonuses are official, and dated tables corroborate the pinned HP and upgrade data, but spawned-unit level, geometry and timing are insufficient for a faithful deterministic Core actor.
